commands: git status --porcelain; echo "---ENV---"; echo "RUN_ID=$GITHUB_RUN_ID ATTEMPT=$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"; echo "---BASE---"; .prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/config-get.sh .base_branch main

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1478/31295376146-1
gh pr diff 1478 | awk '/^diff --git/{in_logs=/ [ab]\/\.prflow\/logs\//} !in_logs' | tee .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1478/31295376146-1/diff.patch | tail -5
echo "---rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}---"

echo "=== shallow? ==="; git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository
echo "=== count ==="; git rev-list --count HEAD
echo "=== do the cited commits exist? ==="
for c in 7b2943c94 9a79f02e8 adc88267f b7e3bc867 8836e08457 a688e739f 1248e5e624 395e2c620 76772a133 47a4751639; do
  printf '%s: ' "$c"; git cat-file -t "$c" 2>/dev/null || echo "MISSING"
done

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp
if rm -f ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-disabled" 2>/dev/null &&
   git status --porcelain -z > ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" &&
   [ -f ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ] &&
   [ ! -L ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ] &&
   git hash-object ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before"; then
  echo "SNAP-OK"
else
  printf '%s\n' disabled > ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-disabled"
  echo "SNAP-DISABLED"
fi
for c in 7b2943c94 adc88267f 9a79f02e8 b7e3bc867 8836e08457 a688e739f 76772a133 1248e5e624 395e2c620; do printf "%s " "$c"; git cat-file -t "$c" 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING; done
for c in 7b2943c94 adc88267f 9a79f02e8 b7e3bc867 8836e08457 a688e739f 76772a133 1248e5e624 395e2c620; do t=$(git cat-file -t "$c" 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING); echo "$c $t"; done

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow
for c in 7b2943c94 adc88267f 9a79f02e8 b7e3bc867 8836e08457 a688e739f 76772a133 1248e5e624 395e2c620; do
  printf '%s ' "$c"; git log -1 --format='%ci %s' "$c" 2>&1 | head -1
done
for c in 7b2943c94 adc88267f 9a79f02e8 b7e3bc867 8836e08457 a688e739f 76772a133 1248e5e624 395e2c620; do printf '%s ' "$c"; git log -1 --format='%ci %s' "$c" 2>&1 | head -1; done
